subject: Incremental top-up bands, co-term option, and invoice timing
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@clearwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-contract top-up and co-term question

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Quick summary: our usage is ramping faster than we modeled and procurement asked whether we can add capacity mid-contract. We are looking at a 3–6 month top-up in the range of $60k–$150k consumption (estimated tokens) and would prefer to co-term with our current annual renewal (Jan 1, 2026) rather than a separate 12-month commit.

Two asks from our side:
- What discount bands do you offer on incremental top-ups if we take a pro-rata top-up vs if we annualize the incremental spend through Jan 1, 2026?
- If we go the annualize route, can billing be aligned so Clearwell receives a single amendment invoice (not split monthly)? Procurement also needs a target PO amount/expiry date — they asked for a 7/1 deadline.

I've attached our Q2 usage export to give context (usage_report_q2.csv).

Budget context: finance wants to stay within an additional $120k headroom for the remainder of the year if possible. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Shah
Head of AI Platform
Clearwell Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clearwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mid-contract top-up and co-term question

Hi Amit — thanks for the context and the report. I pasted the high-level options below so procurement has something to review; I'll follow up with a short PDF summary (attached) and loop in finance/legal for the amendment template.

Options (high-level):
1) Pro-rata top-up (short-term, no change to term)
   - Discount: 8% off list for single top-up under $75k; 12% for $75k–$150k (volume band).
   - Billing: invoiced at time of top-up (one invoice), standard payment NET30.

2) Annualize the incremental spend into your existing term (co-term to Jan 1, 2026)
   - Discount: 15% off the incremental annualized commitment if we can convert by 7/1 and sign amendment.
   - Billing: one amendment invoice for the annualized amount (can be prepaid or invoiced NET30 at effective date).
   - Benefit: price protection for the remainder of the co-term and higher priority in our capacity planning.

3) Hybrid (staged annualize)
   - Immediate pro-rata top-up to cover near-term need + commitment to annualize remaining estimate within 30 days for a blended discount (typically midpoint of band ~11%).

Our ask for procurement: target PO by 2025-07-01 to secure the 15% annualize band. If procurement needs a different expiry we can try to bridge but approvals/credit will be required.

Next steps:
- I attached a one-page options summary (marissa-topup-options-20250609.pdf).
- Ben, can you confirm whether the 15% is doable from pricing ops and whether we should route through a voucher/annualize workflow?
- Soojin, copying you for legal on amendment template and the single-invoice ask.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min sync with Amit + procurement tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mid-contract top-up and co-term question

Marissa — quick internal note / recommendation before I respond to Amit:

- Pricing ops: We can support the 15% annualize band if the incremental annualized ARR is >= $100k and we receive a PO by 2025-07-01. For $60k–$100k we typically put the band at 12%.
- Billing: Finance can issue one amendment invoice at effective date; payment terms can be NET30 or prepaid (procurement preference). For annualized offers we prefer a single amendment invoice to simplify revenue recognition but we can accommodate monthly invoicing if required (need to flag to revenue ops).
- Legal: please confirm whether the standard Amendment-to-MSA template is sufficient for a co-term that shortens the effective period to Jan 1, 2026 (we're essentially adding incremental $ and aligning term). If legal needs a tailored clause for capacity priority, flag it now.

Recommended external answer: present both pro-rata and annualize paths with clear PO deadline and recommended banding (12% / 15%). Offer a hybrid if they want to split. Also flag that if procurement needs split invoices we can do that but it may push the 15% off the table.

Attaching nothing here — internal.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Mid-Market Sales
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@clearwell.com>, procurement@clearwell.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mid-contract top-up and co-term question

Amit — thanks for the patience while we lined up internal approvals. Summary and recommended path below so procurement has a single ask for the PO: 

Agreed commercial path (recommended):
- Convert incremental estimated spend of $120k into an annualized co-term to Jan 1, 2026.
- Discount: 15% off the incremental annualized amount (DL-2025-347).
- Invoice: single amendment invoice issued at the effective date (we can mark as prepaid or NET30 per your procurement preference).
- PO target: please aim to have a PO to us by 2025-07-01 to lock the 15% band. If PO is later than 7/8 we may need to revalidate pricing.

If procurement needs a short-term bridge we can do: immediate pro-rata top-up for the near-term (billed when added) + an amendment to annualize the remainder; blended discount would be ~11% in that hybrid scenario.

Attached: draft amendment (amendment_clearwell_annualize_draft.pdf) and the option summary I mentioned previously. I've also created the HubSpot deal and attached the DocuSign envelope for signature: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABCDEF-2025-Clearwell (link).

Next step: Amit — can you confirm procurement's preferred invoice handling (prepay vs NET30) and whether you can target PO by 7/1? If yes I'll issue the DocuSign and route to finance for single-invoice issuance.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
